shots.caption: In Freak Melee, your characters belong to you!
shots.direction: Mario turns toward camera. The familiar fighter becomes your first editable clone.

shots.caption: Tweak the hitboxes...
shots.direction: Match cut from the real Action Editor to the edited attack. Show a modest range change before the later overpowered gag.
shots.pending: Record the actual edit and its gameplay result.

shots.caption: ...the animations...
shots.direction: Scrub an authored pose in Animation, then cut to that pose moving in-game. Keep the same view direction across the cut.
shots.pending: Author and record the changed animation.

shots.caption: ...the code!
shots.direction: Show a few readable lines in Scripting. Cut to a visibly altered special, followed by the fighter landing in the same composition.
shots.pending: Choose a small scripted change and film its real result.

shots.caption: Show off your one-of-a-kind fighters online.
shots.direction: Film the real tile-to-player delivery, then the received fighter appearing on the other player's CSS.
shots.pending: Capture a local two-client delivery with test accounts.

shots.caption: There aren't any limits. Against strangers, expect anything...
shots.direction: A low-percent victim is launched by one absurdly strong hit. Smash cut to a taunting Ganondorf behind a deliberately excessive CENSORED bar.
shots.pending: Author the gag clone and film the KO. The censored board uses a fully clothed stock model.

shots.caption: You can disable custom fighter appearances in Settings.
shots.direction: Mid-taunt, a puff of smoke replaces the censored fighter with a neutral hurtbox-shaped wireframe. Jigglypuff sings; the wireframe falls asleep.
shots.pending: Implement and verify the actual appearance filter before filming this setting. Wireframe design and sleep gag need staging.

shots.caption: Keep the moves. Change the look. Swag up your fighters!
shots.direction: Four Falcos drop in one at a time, land on the beat, then taunt. Final film uses distinct outfits; stock colors establish spacing in this study.
shots.pending: Choose four actual outfit packages and record drop / landing / taunt transitions.

shots.caption: Be prepared for anything in Freak Melee!
shots.direction: Hold the lineup; resolve to the Freak Melee logo. Fade into the live first-fighter carousel.
